channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Terry Waters announces candidacy for Alabama Senate District 22
item.description: The Robertsdale farmer and veteran drew on his military service and agricultural roots while launching a campaign for Alabama's Senate District 22.

item.title: Muslim rights group joins calls for clemency for Alabama inmate
item.description: Civil rights advocates urged Gov. Kay Ivey to spare a 75-year-old prison mentor facing execution for a murder he did not personally commit.

item.title: Mobile City Council funds DA to avoid prosecutor layoffs
item.description: Mobile city leaders approved $1.1 million annually for prosecutorial services to prevent significant staffing cuts and avoid delays in criminal trials.

item.title: Mobile, Hoover pause internet sales tax challenge
item.description: Municipal leaders dropped their legal challenges to Alabama’s online sales tax system to negotiate a faster legislative fix during the current session.

item.title: Bill passes Senate allowing UA to reorganize School of Social Work despite public pushback
item.description: “HB152 would be a unique action against a nationally ranked, highly productive professional school,” one critic of the bill stated.

item.title: Committee passes bill to prohibit vaping in public spaces
item.description: Alabama lawmakers moved Wednesday to include electronic nicotine delivery systems in the state’s indoor smoking ban while honoring Senator Vivian Figures.

item.title: Senate committee hears public input on bill to regulate police pursuits
item.description: Law enforcement officers and family of youths killed as a result of vehicular pursuits shared opposing stances on proposed police chase regulations.

item.title: House committee considers bill to deny bail based on immigration status
item.description: ​​The House Judiciary Committee debated a bill to deny bail for undocumented defendants charged with violent crimes.

item.title: Democrats want to give people an opportunity to vote on a state lottery
item.description: State Representative Phillip Ensler is planning a new lottery push, and it promises to be popular with voters.

item.title: Senate committee approves abstinence-based sex ed bill
item.description: An Alabama Senate committee advanced legislation Thursday requiring public schools to exclusively teach sexual risk avoidance, effectively rebranding abstinence-only sex education.
